description_localkey:
The older of the twin maids who works at Roswaal Mansion.
She used to be a prodigy of the Demons, where she once possessed immeasurable power.
This power, however, has vanished ever since she lost her horn.

element_details.element_desc_localekey: Injects Code: A.N.M.I. to all iron-type enemies, dealing 10% additional damage.

piece_detail.description_localkey:
Used for a Nikke's Limit Break.
Spare Bodies for a fully enhanced Nikke will be converted into Body Labels.

shot_detail.description_localkey:
■ Affects target(s).
<color=#00AEFF>Deals {damage}% of ATK as damage.
Charge Time: {charge_time} sec.
Full Charge Damage: {full_charge_damage}% of damage.
Deals {core_damage_rate}% damage when attacking core.</color>

skill2_detail.description_localkey:
■ Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Max HP ▲ {description_value_01}% without restoring HP for {description_value_02} sec.</color>
■ Affects {description_value_03} ally unit(s) with the lowest remaining HP.
<color=#00AEFF>DEF ▲ {description_value_04}% of the skill user's DEF for {description_value_05} sec.</color>

skill1_detail.description_localkey:
■ Activates after landing {description_value_01} normal attacks. Affects the target.
<color=#00AEFF>ATK ▼ {description_value_02}% for {description_value_03} sec.</color>
■ Activates when Full Burst ends if an ally from the same squad is present. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF><word_group=10031>Cooldown</word_group> of Burst Skill ▼ {description_value_04} sec.</color>

ulti_skill_detail.description_localkey:
■ Affects all allies.
<color=#00AEFF>Creates a <word_group=10023>shield</word_group> with HP equal to {description_value_01}% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> max HP that lasts for {description_value_02} sec.</color>

character_dialog_group_list.speech_localkey: I'm busy resting right now, so what business do you have with me?
Why are you giving me that look? It's creepy.
Have you seen Rem by any chance? I hope she isn't pushing herself too hard.
As you can see, I'm both pitiful and in perfect health. Remember this look well.
I'll share the cookies Rem baked, you should feel ever so grateful.
You look pretty calm. Well, maybe that's for the best, since you can't really relax when you're too tense.
You manage to make me bored... Your audacity truly knows no limits.
Taking care of me should be your top priority, so you should be ashamed of yourself, you know.
Rem handles most of the chores, while I'm primarily in charge of observation.
To yawn continuously is a telltale sign of the vacuity of one's mind. *Yawn*
Such unusual buildings, such esoteric outfits... this reminds me of something someone once told me.
I am Ram, an employee of Lord Roswaal. I am to be under your employ for the interim.
I still have more to give.
Now, I can show you what I can do.
I'm starting to feel like my old self again...
Well, well, what do we have here?
Someone's feeling generous, huh?
I appreciate the sentiment.
I must say, you don't seem like such a bad person.
I'll prepare tea for you. Do you have quality tea leaves here?
Thanks are in order.
So, you need my help?
I guess I have no choice.
Just get on with it.
I'll make sure to settle this account.
You are really making me work.
How irksome.
Fine, I'll cooperate.
I need a short break. One moment.
I'm a bit tired.
I'll leave this to you for a bit.
I'm ready.
I'll make you regret this!
Let's wrap this up. Once and for all.
As if this was going to end any other way.
This is all thanks to me being here.
This was a waste of my time.
Ow!
Tsk!
Ugh!
Lord Roswaal, I apologize...
You mess with the Ram, you get the horns.
